retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy monochrome portrait featuring a close-up subject with smoke and distorted, blocky typography on a white bar.
triggerTerms: distorted block lettering on white bar

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast monochrome close-up of a male face looking downward, partially obscured by smoke, featuring a prominent skull-themed accessory and a horizontal white bar containing vertically stretched, distorted sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face dominates the upper right quadrant
White typographic bar acts as a horizontal anchor on the left
Smoke creates a soft, organic texture contrasting with sharp facial features
Deep shadows in the lower half provide a heavy visual base
coreInvariants: High-contrast duotone or monochrome color palette
Heavy film grain or halftone texture throughout
Typography contained within a solid geometric bar
Extreme close-up framing of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject positioned off-center to the right, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white horizontal bar on the left side containing the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright forehead, moves down to the eyes, follows the smoke to the skull accessory, and ends at the typographic bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and atmospheric smoke.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey for highlights and the typographic bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle sepia or greenish tint within the monochrome range.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between deep blacks and blown-out highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Negative space cutouts within the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sliced horizontally to create a vibrating or distorted effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme vertical distortion paired with extreme horizontal extension.

preserve: Vertical stretching of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, condensed skeleton needed for the vertical distortion.
Matches the wide, blocky aesthetic of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy monochrome close-up portrait of a man with a bandana, looking down, with thick smoke rising from the bottom right. Include a small skull-shaped object in his hand.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid white horizontal bar on the left. Inside the bar, place vertically stretched, black, distorted sans-serif text. Below the bar, add a line of wide-tracked, white extended sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main text vertically stretched and distorted?
Is the image high-contrast monochrome with visible grain?
Is the subject's face partially obscured by smoke?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretch on the main title
Amount of smoke obscuring the face
Width of the white typographic bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white bar does not span the entire width.
Check that the grain doesn't wash out the facial highlights.
Verify the text distortion looks intentional and jagged.
Confirm the monochrome tint is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + smoke + distorted condensed type in a bar + extended subtitle.
